text: Equity is based on fairness.
Describe the development of Equity and assess how far the statement above is true. [25]
Ishmael has been convicted of burglary at the Crown Court. He has been sentenced to five years’
imprisonment. The prosecution considers this sentence too lenient and Ishmael insists that he is
innocent.
Outline the routes of appeal open to the prosecution and defence. Discuss the factors likely to be
considered when deciding whether or not to appeal. [25]
Explain the role and work of the Law Commission. Evaluate its contribution to the development of
the law. [25]
There are advantages to using magistrates to administer justice but such vital matters should only
be dealt with by those who are legally qualified.
Describe both the civil and criminal role of magistrates and assess how far the statement above is
true. [25]
Explain the various forms of alternative dispute resolution (ADR) and evaluate their effectiveness
in resolving civil disputes. [25]
Describe the education and training of solicitors and assess how well it prepares them for the work
they do. [25]
